scope: Source and saved JSON metadata only; not execution admission or recovered-array validation
closed_findings: Required local JSON/Python input inventory now includes immutable R2 evidence pins and the24 CHAIN sources; authoritative metadata hashes are checked independently of execution-contract pins.
All36 NPZ parsing calls now use BytesIO over bounded captured bytes checked against the frozen candidate/control/joined hashes; final captured-input equality detects persistent changes.
The local180-second origin now precedes main preflight; remote bytecode writes are disabled before third-party imports.
Separate original failure/recovered artifact statuses and no-retry/no-new-inference boundaries remain explicit.
Renderer and HTML adapter delta receipts reproduce their current sources byte-for-byte with original-source hashes unchanged.

required_findings.title: The180-second checks do not bound blocking local work
required_findings.evidence: NAS file reads, NumPy import/NPZ decompression and final unbounded read_bytes run between cooperative checks. Only remote commands and scp receive subprocess timeouts. A stalled local operation can exceed180 seconds before check() runs.
required_findings.required: Use a separately owned CPU audit process with an outer180-second deadline and exact PID/create-time ownership, or an equivalent bounded supervisor. The original shared stage deadline also applies. Successful consumption requires a confirmed zero exit and within-budget completion; do not extend or reset either clock. No new inference or retry is authorized.

required_findings.title: The reported peak is sampled current RSS, not the actual process peak
required_findings.evidence: rss() returns WorkingSetSize although PeakWorkingSetSize is available. Transient allocation can exceed1GiB between checks and disappear before the next sample; the receipt currently labels max(sampled current RSS) as peak_local_RSS_bytes.
required_findings.required: Read and enforce actual PeakWorkingSetSize, including after array operations and at final process completion. Bound NPY declared shapes/dtypes/bytes before allocation or enforce the allocation cap externally. Record actual peak and reject any cap breach; do not rename sampled values as measured peak.

required_findings.title: A post-pointer failure leaves a consumable PASS pointer
required_findings.evidence: The PASS receipt is written, then the success pointer is written at206, then check() can raise at207. The except block creates RECOVERY_FAILURE, but current renderer/packager do not reject that failure or require successful terminal completion.
required_findings.required: Publish/consume a final success marker only after the owned collector has exited zero within all limits. A recovery failure marker, missing terminal evidence or unfinished owner must always override a PASS receipt/pointer. Preserve any partial records rather than deleting or rewriting original evidence.

required_findings.title: The recovered binding proof is consumed by status/count only
required_findings.evidence: The adapter verifies the proof hash and12-row count, but never compares proof row identities and candidate/control/joined pins to the arrays it subsequently consumes.
required_findings.required: Require the exact unique fixed12 case/step set and each corresponding candidate/control/joined path, SHA and byte size to match the proof. Require exact native-ID/reference proof flags and bind the scalar-comparison qualification described below. The public package must preserve this qualification.

required_findings.title: The public-package delta receipt is stale
required_findings.evidence: The receipt declares adapted SHA349425694fc1fbd9d27baa253c7e0019190c986af735cea32b7443c640fec376; actual current packager SHA is1d7d42510069e4abbf1d08c38f799f69d1a6f26e7e1cce804e210fe08cbd5a04. Declared string-change counts and exact-byte reconstruction also fail.
required_findings.required: Regenerate the delta evidence for the actual reviewed source, preserving its current execution-contract/source linkage checks. Do not revert correct checks simply to match an older receipt.

scalar_anchor_policy.r2_interpretation: R2 calls saved anchors consistency inspection; it does not preregister1e-10 as a validated tolerance for separate CUDA inference.
scalar_anchor_policy.immutable_scientific_rules: Existing703-metric saved-arithmetic replay tolerance and all scientific/no-harm decision thresholds remain unchanged.
scalar_anchor_policy.required_binding_gates: All12 exact native IDs/order, references, support, finite values, source/checkpoint/graph identity and immutable expected bytes remain mandatory.
scalar_anchor_policy.anchor_handling: For all12, record saved and recovered vector/magnitude nRMSE, signed recovered-minus-saved delta in percentage points, absolute delta, and whether existing rel/abs1e-10 comparison matches. Do not invent a new numerical tolerance or claim GPU determinism.
scalar_anchor_policy.nonmatching_anchor: Classify SCALAR_DIFFERENCE_UNEXPLAINED. This is not a failure of an already-proven byte/native-ID binding and is not a scientific-improvement result. Recovered contours may only be auxiliary stored-inference artifacts, never field evidence reproducing the saved evaluation. Any difference must remain visible in the all12 comparison table and propagated to PNG/HTML/package scope; without that disclosure omit candidate contours.
scalar_anchor_policy.current_code_change_needed: Replace the unconditional close()-raises gate and scalar_anchor_exact_existing_tolerance=True with a non-relaxed explicit comparison result and recorded deltas; preserve nonfinite/structural failures as hard failures. Freeze this interpretation in the source/execution contract before any recovery attempt.

adapter_review.html: Source delta verified; existing arithmetic and disclosed operational failure preserved; final admission depends on upstream qualified terminal receipt and visible all12 anchor comparison.
